# Rotaract Club of Metro City

> Primary site for programs, events, campaigns, impact metrics, stories, and contact details.

## Site
- Name: Rotaract Club of Metro City
- Tagline: People of Action
- Canonical base URL: https://brianhexer.github.io/RID3206-Clubs-WS/
- Organization type: Youth-led community service organization
- Focus areas: Healthcare access, education and skills, sustainability, youth leadership

## High-Confidence Facts
- The site publishes measurable impact metrics across health, education, and climate work.
- The events page lists upcoming volunteer activities and locations.
- The campaigns page includes fundraising targets and current progress.
- The stories page contains testimonials and FAQ-style answers.
- Contact options include email, phone, and a local center address.
